verdict.rationale: Snyk has agentic remediation tools (Remediation Agent, `snyk fix --agentic`, `/snyk-fix`/`/snyk-batch-fix`) that scan, generate fix plans, apply and verify fixes, but these are triggered on-demand by a human/coding assistant rather than running fully autonomously on a background schedule; CI/CD integration exists but is not framed as an unattended, self-triggering automation. missing for 10: evidence of scheduled/event-driven autonomous triggers without human invocation, background/headless operation independent of CI/CD or IDE prompts, and confirmation the Remediation Agent runs without human-in-the-loop approval.
